utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can contribute a little, though I’m keeping things simple right now. Thanks for organizing the repair drive, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. How much would you like to put in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do 20 euros this time. I’d appreciate it if you kept it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing first, and when should we start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Let’s start with the biggest safety issues first, then move to the urgent fixes; if you’re good with it, we can begin Saturday morning and sort the rest after.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—let’s start Saturday morning and tackle the safety issues first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up nicely — I can swing by after errands and drop off a few things if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would help a lot, Ira — thank you. I’ll make sure there’s a spot ready when you swing by after errands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll stop by after I’m done and bring a few things over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’m just catching the details myself, so I don’t want to mix anything up. If you tell me what you’ve got, I can help make sure it all sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still piecing it together, so I don’t want to guess. If you know the date, location, and what’s being repaired, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around school drop-off and pickup, so just tell me the repair drive time and I’ll plan accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Faye — how about Saturday morning around 10? That should give us a good window for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me — I’ll fit it around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re gathering tools and volunteers later today—if you’ve got a spare hour, it’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can probably spare an hour later. Just let me know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect—meet by the community shed around 4, and I’ll point you to the table with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep track of the repair drive location and make sure Bo has the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — just send me the location when you’ve got it, and I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it covered — I’ll send you the repair drive location as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and where everything should be dropped off first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send you the timing and drop-off location first, then we can plan the repair drive together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me — once I have the timing and drop-off spot, I can figure out the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Noah — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Mara — could you start by sorting the donations and making a quick list of what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations and make a quick list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — could you help spread the word and maybe swing by to sort donations this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can spread the word and I’ll swing by Saturday to help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the repair drive spots—what location do you need me to note for Quinn?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal—please note the repair drive is at my place on Maple Street. I’ll send the exact address and time right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note Maple Street and wait for the exact address and time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—want me to tell the others what’s needed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—I'd really appreciate that. I’m still catching up, so any help getting the word out would be great.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll let everyone know what’s needed and when to show up. If you want, send me the details and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you grab any spare screws, duct tape, and a couple of flashlights? I’ll keep a running list so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can grab those — screws, duct tape, and a couple flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do I need to know about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries—just bring what you can, and we’ll sort it by hand. We’re meeting at the community shed at 10, and I’ll have labels and a checklist ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head to the community shed at 10 and bring a few things I’ve got. Thanks for having the labels and checklist ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I meant to put up a flyer for it; I can still do that today if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please do that today—if it’s not too much trouble. I’m mostly worried people won’t see it in time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course — I’ll put it up this afternoon and make it big and easy to spot. I’ll stop by once it’s done.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what repair items should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you bring a screwdriver set, duct tape, and a few wrenches? That should cover most of it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring those.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring the tools, or should I just come help with the load?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: If you can bring the tools, that’d be a huge help—and if you’ve got time, the load would be great too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can do that—I'll bring the tools and help with the load too. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can bring my tool kit by for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you bring the wrench set and a flashlight? If you have time, I’d also like you to check the loose hinge by the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the wrench set and flashlight, and I’ll take a look at that back gate hinge too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what still needs doing. If you’re going, maybe we can head over together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’d be glad to go with you and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, let’s go together later and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Sam — I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m happy to help get folks signed up. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — let’s start by sorting the list into quick fixes and bigger jobs, then we can sign folks up from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll split everything into quick fixes and bigger jobs, then we can start matching neighbors to the right tasks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely still happening, right? I just want to make sure before I count on it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s still on. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll keep an eye out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive, Rosa—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Rey—thank you. First, let’s make a simple list of the repairs we know about, then we can match people to each one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I’ll start a list of the repairs we know about and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in—count me in for the repair drive. I’ll spread the word to the neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot, Quinn. Thanks for spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll start with the folks on my street and see who can pitch in.
